name: nxtphaseai
description: NxtPhase plugin marketplace for Claude Code.

plugins.name: agent-eval
plugins.description: Auto-grades the agent's last turn against the user prompt — and against optional project rules in eval/eval.md — and appends a red/green scored card to eval/eval.html.

plugins.name: ask-visual
plugins.description: Visual AskUserQuestion: spins up a one-shot localhost HTTP server, serves a custom HTML form (cards, sliders, color pickers, anything), and feeds the user's submission back into the conversation as JSON.

plugins.name: nxtphase-design
plugins.description: Nxt Phase AI brand & design system as an invokable skill. Ships colors, type tokens, fonts, logos, the dot-icon rules, a website UI kit, and a presentation deck template — Dieter Rams / Braun-inspired, warm cream canvas, one Signal Green accent.

plugins.name: nxtphase-demo-video
plugins.description: How Nxt Phase AI makes demo and sales videos, as an invokable skill. Remotion scaffold, the fixed brand end card, the ElevenLabs voice-over pipeline, the method for showing real interfaces instead of redrawing them, the anonymisation rules, a writing-style guide that keeps AI vocabulary and em-dashes out of client copy, a checklist built from real client feedback, an optional English variant of a finished video, and an optional step that publishes the matching demo page in the Notion Demo Library.

plugins.name: nxtphase-documentatie
plugins.description: The two hand-over documents at the end of a project, as an invokable skill. Writes a user manual for the team that uses the tool and a technical documentation for the IT department that runs it, both as editable Word documents in the house style. Verifies every claim against the source code and the live Azure deployment with read-only commands, asks the questions it cannot answer from code instead of guessing, and records the source of each claim. Ships a docx generator that needs nothing but the Python standard library.

plugins.name: deploy-nxtphase-demo
plugins.description: Puts any app on a <name>.demo.nxtphase.ai domain, as an invokable skill. Explores the codebase, creates the Railway project and service in the shared demos workspace, registers the custom domain, writes the CNAME and TXT records in Cloudflare in the order that avoids a cached NXDOMAIN, uploads the source, and verifies the URL answers. Writes a state file so later re-deploys are one step. Ships no credentials: it reads RAILWAY_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN from a .env file the user creates, and points them at our shared password manager, where both values are kept, with a developer on the team as the fallback.

plugins.name: claude-security
plugins.description: Anthropic's own security plugin, listed here so it installs from this marketplace like everything else. Deep vulnerability scanning of your own code, run inside your Claude Code session at a chosen effort tier, with every finding challenged before it is reported. Turns surviving findings into targeted patches, each verified by a panel of agents, that you apply when you choose. Not ours: the source is anthropics/claude-plugins-official, pinned to no version, so you always get what is on their main branch.
